subject: expression: correct the erroneous scalar function equivalence check (#54067)
summary: Adds return-type comparison to `ScalarFunction.Equal` to avoid treating same-name scalar functions with different result types (notably `CAST`) as equivalent; adjusts `FieldType.Equal` to ignore JSON `flen` differences and adds regression coverage for #53726 (RemoveUnnecessaryFirstRow + DISTINCT CAST). No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the scoped areas.
